question: Can learned complex update directions with a query-operator intensity-change bound improve unseen-measurement prediction over matched uniform updates and the same learned directions without that bound?
design_history: Motivated after complete positive-diagonal pilot and truth-dependent direction/trust diagnostics. Radius0.1 was informed by those development diagnostics; it is not claimed independently selected or physically calibrated noise.

model.network: 9->16->16->2 spatial3x3/3x3/1x1 SiLU, zero final layer; one shared network for3internalsteps
model.direction: Coverage-whitened gradient plus a learned real-inner-product-orthogonal complex component; orthogonal norm<=2 gradient norm; normalize total whitened norm to gradient norm; strict visible descent cosine>=1/sqrt5.
model.phase: Existing nine invariant features; phase-equivariant complex latent map
model.query_bound: For fixed current B,D and requested query operator A_Q, derive a sufficient norm cap from Delta I=t v+t^2 a. Smoothed upper norm coefficients, relative smoothing1e-6, radius0.1. Then exact visible quartic line solve on[0,1].
model.state: Single coherent complex field, common original LSQML1000 initialization. No extra object targets.

method.query_positions_train: The same sampled256 permitted outer-training positions; positions enter bound, values only enter outer loss. Duplicate-free with existing cohort.
method.query_positions_validation: All fixed TP query_ids jointly; no query values enter model or bound.
method.query_positions_training_endpoint: All permitted training_ids jointly when recording selected model training endpoints; query-conditioned state may differ from a minibatch-conditioned training state.
method.differentiation: Finite3step full derivatives, isolated quartic branchIFT; query-cap strict clipping branch. Checkpointed query-statistics batches recompute their forward pass during backward. Uncertified branch fails visibly.

optimization.loss: Mean squared normalized experimental intensity on original train IDs
optimization.selection: Lowest TP1/TP2 x3budgets equal relative intensity RMSE; include0, tiesearliest; all44checkpoints retained; bothseeds reported

metrics: TP mean andall6condition errors for eachseed
Matched uniform control at3steps for eachbounded/unbounded variant
Measured training memory/time; inference operator calls accountforadditionalqueryprojections
cost: Eachinnerstep has2visibleforwards+1visibleadjoint. Bounded variants also have2queryforwards; checkpoint recomputation and backprop areadditional. Do not call bounded/unbounded identical totalcost. Comparelearnedtoitsownuniformvariant.
evidence_scope: Development pilot only. Prior LFP/NCM scores remain observed and untouched. A result here cannot establish new-material generalization or CVPR contribution by itself.
decisions: Evaluate full pairedseed/condition results before scaling; distinguish geometry-bound benefit from learned-direction benefit and include unfavourable conditions. No optional optimizer/model grid in this pilot.
